capability.title: Controlled Candidate Creation
capability.outcome: A tiny, exact candidate cohort can be created through dry-run, explicit approval, audited apply and rollback proof.
acceptance_criteria: Apply is impossible without current generic proof.
Affected objects and rollback evidence are visible.
validation: Targeted tests, full pytest, Ruff and DB audit evidence.

stories.title: Candidate Apply-Gate Design
stories.outcome: Exact candidate writes are specified with preview, approval, idempotency and rollback before code writes.
acceptance_criteria: Affected tables/rows and audit events are named.
Approval token and rollback semantics are specified.

stories.title: Controlled Candidate Apply Implementation
stories.outcome: A tiny approved cohort is created once, idempotently, with audit evidence.
validation: Targeted DB integration tests, full pytest, Ruff, CI.

stories.title: Candidate Apply Outcome and Rollback Proof
stories.outcome: Post-apply state, downstream routing and rollback are independently reviewable.
acceptance_criteria: Created candidates have correct lifecycle state and provenance.
Rollback restores prior state without orphaned audit records.
validation: DB audit report and rollback rehearsal.
